title: Runner cost visibility via orchestrator
problem: Runner stages run as Claude subprocesses (claude -p) outside the main session. The budgeter hooks never fire for these, so token consumption across 5+ subprocess calls is a complete black box.
description: Wire cost tracking into the orchestrator: (1) run.py captures token usage from each claude -p subprocess output, (2) after each stage completes, run.py pipes the usage data through budgeter/log_agent_cost.py with the stage name as the agent identifier, (3) at runner end, run.py prints a cost summary showing per-stage and total token usage, (4) costs appear in budgeter report.py output grouped under the runner session.
scope: Modified: runner/run.py (capture subprocess token output, pipe to log_agent_cost.py, print cost summary). No changes to individual stage scripts or budgeter internals.
context: The claude -p command outputs token usage in its response. log_agent_cost.py accepts usage XML from stdin: echo '<usage>...</usage>' | python budgeter/log_agent_cost.py --session-id ID --agent NAME --cwd DIR. The backfill-handoffs agent already uses this pattern successfully.
